summary: Floor-1 server-side aggregate renderer + Floor-2 RLS-gated data API (T-0121g). POST /api/report-pages/:id/render dispatches to renderFloor1 (floor=1, server-side GROUP BY aggregation over registry_def fields) or dataFloor2 (floor=2, RLS-isolated raw paginated data) based on floor. PDP gate on Floor-1: authzDeps.checkReadGrant checks application/read grant via JOIN grant×role_assignment (genesis-owner short-circuit; confirmed_by + validity windows; LIMIT 1). T-0144 discipline: withTenantTx begins transaction before SET LOCAL. MAX_DATA_LIMIT enforced on Floor-2. STALE_DEPENDENCIES (409) and FLOOR_MISMATCH (400) gates. Injectable deps (ReportPageRenderAuthzDeps, resetRenderPoolForTesting). Static fitness check report-page-render-isolation.sh (FF-NF4, AC-AUTHZ, AC-TX, AC-REG). 22 no-DB unit tests + 9 live-DB report_page_render tests + 4 live-DB AC-6 probes (deny×2 + allow×2). RE-REVIEW approved (R-1/R-2/R-3 all resolved). R-6 nit (scope-containment: checkReadGrant not filtered by app_id → grant on App-A covers all tenant pages) deferred as tech-debt to T-0193; ADR §6 states 'через PDP T-0021' as full path. Post-rebase onto dev (T-0179 + T-0180): package.json union-additive (check-report-page-deps.sh + author-report-page-seed.sh + report-page-render-isolation.sh). All CI gates green: tsc 0 errors, eslint 0 errors, fitness all PASS, vitest 1385/1385 passed (68 files), fitness:db 599/599 passed (43 files). T-0121 ADR covered through T-0121a..T-0121g — Reports epic complete.

commits.message: feat(T-0181): Floor-1 server-side aggregate renderer + Floor-2 RLS-gated data API (T-0121g)

findings_resolved: R-1 (blocking) — Floor-1 /render had no PDP gate. Fixed: renderFloor1 now accepts actor/nowMs/authzDeps; calls authzDeps.checkReadGrant fail-early before withTenantTx.

R-2 (blocking) — defaultCheckReadGrant used wrong grant pool (mgmt_object:* grants). Fixed: full rewrite — genesis-owner short-circuit via loadAdminContext; non-genesis path uses correct JOIN grant×role_assignment filtered by resource_type='application', operation='read', confirmed_by IS NOT NULL, validity windows on both grant and role_assignment.

R-3 (blocking) — AC-6 live probe absent. Fixed: ci/checks/db/report_page_render_ac6.test.ts added with 4 live probes (AC-6-DENY-FLOOR1, AC-6-DENY-FLOOR2, AC-6-ALLOW-FLOOR1, AC-6-ALLOW-FLOOR2); all 4 green.
findings_nit: R-4 (nit) — FIELD_KEY_SAFE_RE dashes: documented behavior, no fix required.
R-5 (nit) — denyDeps FakePool no comment: no fix required.
R-6 (nit) — scope-containment: checkReadGrant not filtered by app_id → grant on App-A covers all tenant pages. Deferred to T-0193; ADR §6 states 'через PDP T-0021' as full path.
